final_message: Fixed the previous typecheck failure (TS2835, TS7006) in `external-links.ts`: added the `.js` extension to the `product-repos` import and typed `message` as `string`. All plan work, including the ticket's results section, was already done in the first attempt. tsc on `tsconfig.test.json`, the related tests and `validate:history-links` pass.
handoff: `.specdojo/specdojo.config.json` has no `external_projects` entry for prj-0002, so the existing `[[prj-0002:...]]` wikilinks are not resolved yet. The file is protected from agent edits; add `path`, `project_id` and `source_url` following step 4 of the move guide when prj-0002 moves.

Where the other repository is not checked out (for example in CI), these links stay unresolved. For the public site to resolve them, check out the other repository at the `path` location before the build.
The rendering on the docs site (`npm run docs:build`) has not been checked. The orchestrator runs it once at the end.
VS Code extension wikilink resolution is out of scope. Handle it as a separate item if needed.
